techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/hooks/useEntityArtifacts.ts:19 The hook classifies pipeline step artifacts after the lab is open, not document subresources.

src/components/layout-lab/hooks/useLabActivity.ts:59 The poll is cleared when the React effect ends or the lab suspends. There is no document socket, pagehide handler, or unload registration in this directory.

pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogChangesDigest.tsx:63 The digest's loading state is a single line in an unfixed shell, and the ready list can grow to eight rows above the matrix, so the grid drops when the changes arrive.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogChangesDigest.tsx:63 Shell sets padding and font size but no height. GlobalCoach does reserve its own row (GlobalCoach.tsx:89); this digest does not match that reservation.
src/components/layout-lab/GlobalCoach.tsx:54 A coach click writes an in-memory location. It does not leave the document, so back/forward cache rules are the shell's concern.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useViewportWidth.ts:45 The shell hook used by the home shells defaults to the wide layout and only collapses after a ResizeObserver measurement, so a narrow first viewport moves once script runs.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useViewportWidth.ts:45 useViewportAtLeast seeds state from WIDE_FALLBACK_WIDTH (1440) and updates only inside the effect. AppShell and Baseline both call it for the first-paint column split.
src/app/page.tsx:4 The home route is a client module that also imports NewHome and renders exactly one of them, so the unseen legacy shell is still in the first-load graph.

src/app/layout.tsx:43 Both Geist families are on every document. Neither call passes preload:false; the installed next/font validator defaults preload to true, display to swap, and adjustFontFallback to true.
src/app/layout.tsx:6 The server layout's only stylesheet import is the app's own global CSS. The layout renders no classic parser-blocking script.

pairs.registryProposal: navigation-reuse names an unload listener as the back/forward opt-out and does not say whether a beforeunload listener that only calls preventDefault to confirm in-flight work is the same failure; pagehide cannot show that dialog.

declined.subject: page-load-pipeline
declined.reason: withdrawn after review: reviewer (sonnet): The opacity-0 claim is not about served markup. NewHome.tsx's hydration gate uses getServerSnapshot `() => false`, so the server renders only NewHomeSkeleton and never renders CatalogTree or PipelineRail rows. Both verdicts therefore rest on an unconfirmed claim that the served HTML hides labels.
